tests.name: patrol and turtle_bringup tests: 24 tests, 0 failures
dynamic parameters: 10 to 5 Hz and invalid-value rejection

defect.reproducer: With the publish_hz lower-bound check temporarily disabled, ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 terminated the node with ZeroDivisionError.
defect.root_cause: The timer period was calculated as 1.0 / publish_hz after accepting zero.
defect.proof_after: With validation restored, the same command was rejected, publish_hz remained 5.0, and /patrol stayed active.
